description: Pre-loaded RVT demos (VW1-22) for the rvt-view browser viewer. Each entry points at a file the static-site deploy bundles alongside the viewer, plus enough metadata for a landing-page catalog.
attribution: phi-ag/rvt — 11-release sample family (rac_basic_sample_family.rfa across Revit 2016-2026). Redistribution confirmed in the upstream repo's LICENSE. Synthetic fixtures are generated by rvt-rs (Apache-2.0) and committed IFC fixtures under tests/fixtures/.
license: Redistributable samples only. Family RFAs: upstream phi-ag/rvt sample LICENSE. Synthetic RVT/IFC: Apache-2.0 (rvt-rs).

demos.name: Synthetic MVP fixture (2024)
demos.description: License-free CFB fixture from gen-fixture — exercises the open → status → export shell without requiring the LFS corpus.
demos.expected_quality_note: Partial / scaffold export until real partition-stream typed recovery lands. Useful for status, diagnostics, and export buttons — not full walls/doors/levels.
demos.provenance: Generated at build time by viewer/scripts/stage-demos.mjs via gen-fixture.

demos.name: RAC Basic Sample Family (2024)
demos.description: Family-scale sample — the canonical reference across every rvt-rs test.
demos.expected_quality_note: Honest partial decode: metadata/schema and spatial scaffold; typed project geometry is not claimed.

demos.name: RAC Basic Sample Family (2026)
demos.description: Same family upgraded through every Revit release — shows cross-version reading.
demos.expected_quality_note: Honest partial decode: metadata/schema and spatial scaffold; typed project geometry is not claimed.

demos.name: Synthetic IFC project fixture
demos.description: Hand-built IFC4 fixture — shows what the exporter produces without a Revit input. Not opened by the RVT parser; download/reference only.
demos.expected_quality_note: Reference IFC4 with typed elements from synthesized inputs. Viewer cannot parse IFC as input.

demos.name: Synthetic structural fixture
demos.description: Columns + beams + structural framing — exercises the IfcMember routing + RepresentationMap paths. Download/reference only.
demos.expected_quality_note: Reference IFC4 structural sample. Viewer cannot parse IFC as input.

schema_note: Frontend loader reads the staged catalog at /demos/catalog.json (copied from this file by viewer/scripts/stage-demos.mjs), copies redistributable binaries to /demos/, and renders a gallery with provenance + expected quality labels. The element_count_hint is a display value — the actual viewer runs its own element enumeration on load.
privacy_note: Every demo listed here has redistribution rights confirmed. Demo bytes are same-origin static assets fetched only when the user clicks a gallery entry (or during initial catalog load). Adding a new demo requires either (a) the contributor holds copyright and chooses to open-source it, or (b) the file is already under an open license allowing redistribution (e.g. phi-ag/rvt's MIT / sample-content clause). See docs/viewer-privacy-posture.md (VW1-21) for the broader client-side-only posture.
